extDescription.message: Listen to the article you are reading, with your own Crieur. It reads the page your browser shows you, including your subscriptions.

actionTitle.message: Listen to this article with Crieur

menuRead.message: Listen to this article with Crieur

errorSetup.message: Set the address of your Crieur server first.

errorPermission.message: The extension needs the right to reach your Crieur server: save the options again and accept.

errorPage.message: The browser does not let extensions read this page (browser, store or PDF page).

errorNoArticle.message: No article found on this page.

errorNoText.message: Too little text to read aloud.

errorLanguage.message: Crieur reads French and English only.

errorTooLong.message: This page is too long to send.

errorToken.message: Your Crieur server refused the API token: check it in the options.

errorRefused.message: Your Crieur server refused the request.

errorUnreachable.message: Your Crieur server cannot be reached: is it running at this address?

errorServer.message: Your Crieur server could not take the article.

optionsLede.message: Crieur reads the article of the page you are viewing and sends it to your own Crieur server, which reads it aloud.

optionsServerHint.message: The address you open Crieur with. The browser asks once for the right to reach it.

optionsToken.message: API token (if the server has one)

optionsTokenHint.message: The value of CRIEUR_API_TOKEN on the server. Kept in this browser only.

optionsInvalidServer.message: Enter an http or https address, for instance http://127.0.0.1:8000.

optionsPrivacyTitle.message: What the extension does with your pages

optionsPrivacy1.message: It reads a page only when you ask it to: the toolbar button, its keyboard shortcut or the menu of the page.

optionsPrivacy2.message: It sends the article and its address to the server above, and nowhere else. No cookie, no browsing history, no analytics.

optionsPrivacy3.message: It reads what your browser already shows you: it never gets around a login or a subscription.
